instruction.text: A baker uses 3 cups of flour to make a cake. He has to make 5 cakes for a party. If there are 7 cups of flour in a bag, how many bags of flour does he need to buy?

atoms.b: Number of bags of flour needed: <mat><gap>15</gap>:<gap>7</gap>=?</mat>
Therefore, the baker needs to buy <mat><gap>3</gap></mat> bags of flour.

instruction.text: A village hall has 8 rows of chairs with 7 chairs in each row. These chairs are rearranged so that there are now 5 chairs in each row. What is the greatest number of rows that can be made?

atoms.b: Therefore, the greatest number of rows that can be made is 11.

instruction.text: A bakery produces 180 bread rolls a day for 5 days. If they sell them in batches of 8, what is the greatest number of batches they can sell?

atoms.b: Therefore, the greatest number of batches the bakery can sell is 112.

instruction.text: A sports team orders 82 custom tops for a tournament. If each player needs 3 away and 3 home tops, how many players can get a full set of tops?

atoms.b: Players that can get a full set: <mat><gap>82</gap>:<gap>6</gap>=?</mat>
Therefore, 13 players can get a full set of tops.

instruction.text: A cafeteria has 62 apples and 53 oranges to distribute evenly among 8 baskets. What is the minimum amount of fruit each basket will get?

atoms.b: Therefore, each basket will get a minimum of 14 pieces of fruit.
